name: Spotify
recommendation: Safe to disable. Spotify does not need to start with Windows.

name: Discord
recommendation: Safe to disable. Discord can be opened manually when needed.

name: Steam
recommendation: Safe to disable. Steam takes significant boot resources.

name: EpicGamesLauncher
recommendation: Safe to disable. Launch games launcher on demand.

name: Adobe Creative Cloud
recommendation: Safe to disable. Multiple background updaters slow down boot.

name: OneDrive
recommendation: Safe to disable if you do not use Microsoft Cloud sync continuously.

name: Skype
recommendation: Safe to disable unless required immediately at login.

name: Cortana
recommendation: Safe to disable. Not needed for core Windows functions.

name: Microsoft Teams
recommendation: Optional. High memory consumption during Windows boot.

name: CCleaner
recommendation: Safe to disable. Background monitoring is redundant.

name: Dropbox
recommendation: Safe to disable if you only sync files occasionally.

name: Google Drive
recommendation: Safe to disable if not actively syncing files at startup.

name: Razer Synapse
recommendation: Optional. Lighting profiles work onboard, safe to disable if not switching macros.

name: Logitech G HUB
recommendation: Optional. Peripheral manager adds noticeable delay to startup.

name: Battle.net
recommendation: Safe to disable. Start games manually.

name: utorrent
recommendation: Safe to disable. Torrent clients consume network and disk IO at startup.

name: qbittorrent
recommendation: Safe to disable. Launch when downloading only.

name: Zoom
recommendation: Safe to disable. Run when joining meetings.

name: SecurityHealthSystray
recommendation: Keep enabled. Windows Security notification tray.

name: Windows Defender
recommendation: Keep enabled. Crucial antivirus protection.

name: Realtek HD Audio
recommendation: Recommended to keep for headphone jack auto-detection.
